easter-egg:1.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series
easter-egg:1.text: Both HADES and the Eclipse cultists use the symbol of a black circle with a red line intersecting it from below; this image is also used as the logo for the Decima game engine, which was developed by Guerrilla Games for use in the Horizon and Killzone series.

easter-egg:2.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series
easter-egg:2.text: The Stranded Items found across the game are references to Death Stranding, which was developed by Kojima Productions in close collaboration with Guerrilla Games. The inventory icons of the Stranded Items are a silhouette of Ludens, Kojima Productions' mascot.

easter-egg:3.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series
easter-egg:3.text: East of the Bandit Camp at Devil's Thirst, directly next to Metal Flower Mark I (D), there are rabbits identified by the Focus as Jazz and Jack, in reference to the Jazz Jackrabbit series. Guerrilla Games was founded in part by members of Orange Games, a studio which developed Jazz Jackrabbit 2.

easter-egg:4.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series
easter-egg:4.text: The Ancient Vessel "KZ" depicts a Helghast Assault Infantry soldier, as seen on the European box art of Killzone 3, another title developed by Guerrilla Games. Vessel 07 KZ.png|"KZ" Ancient Vessel Killzone 3 Cover.JPG|Killzone 3 box artwork

easter-egg:5.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series
easter-egg:5.text: During the cutscene The Good News, the silhouette of a Metroid larva can briefly be seen as part of an evolutionary tree.

easter-egg:6.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series
easter-egg:6.text: The Vantage Point Denver Stadium contains a logo for RIGS: Mechanized Combat League, a VR game produced by Guerrilla's sister studio, Guerrilla Cambridge.
